nom: Pacifica Glow Baby Enzyme Face Scrub with Vitamin C & Glycolic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or breakout-prone skin report the scrub is too mild to cut through their skin's oils, with one noting it caused breakouts from residue left behind.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry combination skin notes slight dryness after use, while others with dry skin describe it as leaving skin soft, plumped and not stripped.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin found it non-irritating, brightening, hydrating and smoothing, though it left her skin a little dry afterward.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most consistently satisfied group, repeatedly describing the scrub as gentle with no irritation, though one reviewer says it made her sensitive skin burn and turn red.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 30s describes her skin as looking more youthful and less lackluster after use.

concerns.aging: A reviewer in her 30s reports her skin looks more youthful and less lackluster after use; another notes improved skin tone and texture over time.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report no dryness or stripping, describing skin as soft, smooth and not dried out, but two reviewers note their skin felt drier after use and one describes her dry sensitive skin burning and turning red.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says the scrub reduced the appearance of her redness; another with dry, sensitive skin reports the opposite, that it caused burning and bright redness.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer avoiding AHA/BHA products found this scrub gentle enough not to leave her skin sensitized or sunburned-feeling.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says it helped fade scabbing/scarring from a pimple; another reports it reduces dry patches around healing blemishes.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report no new breakouts and continued clear skin (including one whose daughter says it kept monthly acne from returning), but one reviewer with oily skin reports it caused her to break out repeatedly and stopped using it.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product left her skin feeling slightly oily after rinsing, and another with oily skin felt it didn't penetrate her natural oils enough to exfoliate effectively.

aspects.libelle: Hard to rinse off, leaves residue

extraits.texte: I received a sample product in exchange for an honest review so here it is. I'm not a fan of this scrub for a couple of reasons, the first is the exfoliant is too mild for my oily skin and second it's really creamy and leaves a residue that caused me to break out within the first couple of washes. I tried this as a daily cleanser and as a once a week cleanser in my normal routine and it's caused me to break out to the point I won't use it anymore.

I wanted a face scrub. I've used it a few times. I really like it! I have sensitive combination skin. It doesn't irritate. It brightens, hydrates, and smooths skin. It's gentle. Easy to use. Smells like oranges, Vitamin C, lightly fragranced. Clean ingredients, vegan, and C. F. Affordable. I rated it 4 stars because after use, my skin gets a little dry. Pacifica is a good brand! One of my favorite brands! Good purchase!
I have super dry skin and it is very sensitive. This is not good for people with skin like mine because it will make your face burn and turn bright red.

This...is very creamy with little bits of exfoliating material. I have always had breakout-prone skin, so think more oily than normal skin. That means this creamy scrub didn't seem to really penetrate my skin's natural oils and exfoliate. However, that doesn't mean this isn't a good product. My mom has oily skin too, but as she is older, I want her to use a more gentle exfoliator scrub. So if you are looking for gentle, choose this. I am not, so I will be looking for a stronger option.

A great way to instantly soften your skin. I use it on my face and body and my skin looks so much more youthful. Im in my 30s now n my skin can sometimes be life luster and need a boost and this just gives you exactly what you need. I love how its not too harsh or way too abrasive. I have pretty sever acne with sensitive skin and i use this every other day to get that perfect dewy soft skin. It even helps for your skincare to absorb better.

Calling all my sensitive skin girlies - this is THE face scrub for you! I'm so glad I tried this out and now it's a staple in my routine. I use it a couple times a week now, but used it every day starting out with no irritation on my very sensitive skin. It's gentle, cleans deeply, removes dead skin, and smells incredible! I adore the orange/vanilla creamsicle scent but I LOVE how soft my skin is after using this - give this one a try!
Glow baby scrub is amazing! My face is so soft and the redness is less noticeable.
